hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve AMM hook backed by Euler Finance lending vaults. It intercepts every swap in beforeSwap, computes amounts using a proprietary curve (CurveLib), then settles by depositing input tokens into and withdrawing output tokens from Euler vaults, returning a BeforeSwapDelta so the pool manager performs no additional CLAMM math. Liquidity additions and donations are intentionally blocked.
